# PlayGo emulator (upstream Kraken Mount v0.3.0)

Bundled file is the unmodified released pgo_stub 0.6 binary by drakmor, copied by Git SHA from quer3q/kraken-mount v0.3.0. Corresponding source: https://github.com/drakmor/pgo_stub/tree/0.6 (GPL-3.0). The loader adds it only when needed. SHA-256 checks apply during the unified build.
